entries.title: Compacting points-to sets through object clustering
entries.key_innovation: Object clustering compacts points-to sets, mapping memory objects into clusters to reduce bit-vector size and accelerate union operations.

entries.title: Declarative static analysis for multilingual programs using codeql
entries.key_innovation: Extends declarative static analyzers like CodeQL to multilingual programs by systematically combining fact databases, rules, and queries across language boundaries.

entries.title: Towards bridging the gap between dalvik bytecode and native code during static analysis of android applications
entries.key_innovation: Reconstructs interactions between Dalvik bytecode and native code to bridge static analysis of Android applications across the Java-native boundary.

entries.title: Static analysis of jni programs via binary decompilation
entries.key_innovation: Uses binary decompilation to statically analyze compiled JNI programs, bypassing unavailable source and overcoming limitations of symbolic-execution-based JN-SAF.

entries.title: Reach me if you can
entries.key_innovation: A reachability analysis technique for identifying code paths or components, as inferred from the title.

entries.title: Safe java native interface
entries.key_innovation: Designs a safe Java Native Interface that enforces Java memory-safety and security policies on native code.

entries.title: Polymorphic type inference for the jni
entries.key_innovation: Introduces polymorphic type inference for the JNI to ensure type-safe interoperation between Java and native code.

entries.title: Cheri jni
entries.key_innovation: Hardware-assisted CHERI-based JNI that enforces Java's memory-safety and isolation guarantees on native code and supports safe direct buffer access.

entries.title: Natidroid
entries.key_innovation: Provides cross-language static analysis of Android native code, as implied by the Natidroid title.

entries.title: Libdroid
entries.key_innovation: Performs data-flow analysis inside Android native libraries to capture flows missed by tools that treat native methods as black boxes.

entries.title: Jni global references are still vulnerable
entries.key_innovation: Devises a new JNI global reference exhaustion DoS attack and JGREAnalyzer tool that detects vulnerable Android services using call-graph and forwarding reachability analysis.

entries.title: Scalability-first pointer analysis with self-tuning context-sensitivity
entries.key_innovation: Introduces self-tuning context-sensitivity that automatically adapts context choices during pointer analysis to balance scalability and precision.
